description: Values mub6_szollosi_deltoid_cover.rs reads instead of computing them. None is evidence for any MUB(6) statement.

extension_psi_base_term.reason: Base term (81/100 - 1/6)^2 added to the triad defect in extension_psi_lower; it is not computed from the candidate basis box and does not depend on the parameter box, so no box can fail. Feeds min_extension_psi_gap, outside_boxes_certified and complete in mub_szollosi_deltoid_cover.json.

cochain_base_edge_defect.reason: Defect on edge 2 -> 0 of the network-simplex fallback cochain; its numerator is the edge value and its denominator the integer scale of the triad edge. Not computed for the box, so Phi1 > 0 whatever the triad defect. Feeds boxes[].phi1_objective in mub_szollosi_deltoid_cover.json.

scalar_box_verified_positive.reason: verified_positive on each box certified by the scalar interval bound is written as true. Feeds boxes[].verified_positive in mub_szollosi_deltoid_cover.json.

network_simplex_box_verified_positive.reason: verified_positive on each box certified by the network-simplex fallback is written as true. Feeds boxes[].verified_positive in mub_szollosi_deltoid_cover.json.
